scope: Faithful finite-support/integer-module algebra only;actual finite fields,projective chart completion,principal divisors and Picard functoriality remain written bridges. No torsion-free point-group hypothesis.
statement: theorem balanced_infinity_images {H : Type} [IntModule H] (finite qplus qminus : H) (m n : Int) (hminus : qminus = -qplus) : finite+(n-1) • qplus+(1-m-n) • qminus = finite+(2*n+m-2) • qplus
